scope: Peptides-func only: existing LCRC learning curves, label statistics, frozen-checkpoint per-label Validation/Train AP, one fixed ECFP4+LightGBM baseline, one longer LCRC-C1 seed0 run

dataset.name: peptides-func
dataset.source: official PyG LRGBDataset Peptides-func fixed train/val/test
dataset.test_policy: terminal; no Test data or Test predictions are opened in any P0/P2 code path

p0_existing_seeds.checkpoint_eval: frozen checkpoint reload; Train and Validation only
p0_existing_seeds.checkpoint_unavailable_policy: record CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE and do not retrain

classifier.other_parameters: LightGBM defaults; no tuning, no early stopping, no tree-count search

p1_ecfp_lgbm.training_rows: official Train only (Train+Validation merged training is forbidden)
p1_ecfp_lgbm.metric: sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score per label; unweighted mean over 10 labels
p1_ecfp_lgbm.row_identity_gate: 10873/2331/2331, disjoint and complete split indices, row-wise identical labels, and atom/bond-level graph identity between SMILES-derived RDKit molecules and the PyG graphs; failure => ROW_ALIGNMENT_BLOCKED

p2_long_run.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss over 10 independent labels (masked for missing labels)
p2_long_run.selection: max Validation mean average precision (macro AP over 10 labels)
p2_long_run.test_access: blocked at runtime by an audit hook

history_reference.note: Fast v1 Test mean AP; recorded only to cross-check the historical report, never used for any choice in this round

literature_background_only.note: not comparable with this round's Train-only Validation number
